body: The owner's yes (08:23, CL28's chat: "take state files and issues out of memory"). On Harmonize, `kit.py compact` (compact_memory) moved 23 state files, awaits.md and 38 closed issues to .story/archive/ but left `.story/awaits-anlon.md` tagging the moved workstreams: Harmonize's story checker (.claude/skills/story/scripts/check.py) gave 31 faults ("awaits-anlon.md: [app] has no state in .story/state/"), the push gate refused, it was reverted (1c6a49c2); the compacted tree is on Harmonize branch `o51-story-compact`. Also the SessionStart hook's STATES section would print nothing. Fix in the kit: compact must handle every awaits file the project has (config memory names, not only awaits.md): either post each open awaits point as a question post and archive the file, or move the awaits points of archived workstreams with them; and it must run the project's memory checker (dry run shows its result) and refuse to leave it red. Test first: a fixture with an awaits-anlon.md tagging a workstream, red on the current kit, green after. Done: kit tests green, kit main fast-forwarded per the trunk push; then a dry run on a fresh Harmonize clone printed in the post (compaction on Harmonize itself is applied by the orchestrator after the check, own commit of git renames).
title: kit compact keeps a project's story checker green
